title.narrative: YR 2 OF 2 PYMNT OF THE PROJ 'PREVENTING DROWNING IN ARTISANAL FISHING COMMUNITI

description.narrative: The aim of the project is to reduce drowning in artisanal fishing communities around Lake Victoria. An estimated 5,000 fishers drown across the whole of Lake Victoria each year and alternative livelihood options are limited. Using learning from a 2021 RNLI socio-economic study, RNLI Ireland will pilot the project with seven core communities around the lake. Through this project, RNLI Ireland will bring together communities who experience drowning with those who have an interest in safety in the water, safer transport, fisheries, gender and diversity and economic empowerment. They will teach drowning prevention skills to fishers and fish processors, enhance drowning prevention in community-led governance structures, train selected individuals within these groups to act as trainers, share progress on drowning prevention at local level and raise awareness. It is also an opportunity for supporting Tanzanian action towards fulfilling actions detailed in the UN Resolution on Global Drowning Prevention.
